summary: All 36 findings from the three source review reports (SPEC-01..21, L01-STD-1..4, ADV-01..11; 13 blocker/major-blocker-equivalent by original severity — precisely 13 blocker, 9 major, 8 minor, 6 note) are accounted for in the fix report's section-3 tables and were re-verified on the current head (0f4811b1c) by re-running the underlying evidence rather than trusting prose. Every gate the fix report names was re-run and reproduced its exact counts: packages/db tenancy-rent-plan.test.mjs 53/53, payroll-settlement.test.mjs 19/19, wave-b/wb-0020-legacy.test.mjs 9/9, the seven-file knowledge/rig-runtime/x56/x42b2/f-a2/firm-document-limits-writer/firm-portfolio-pack battery 82/82, the six-file payroll-summary-facts+payroll-summary-posting+agreement-contract-acquisition+document-capability-registry+tenancy-rent-plan+payroll-settlement battery 172/172, every x42* file + operation-census + rig-isolation 358 pass/20 skip/0 fail, pnpm typecheck exit 0, CI=true GITHUB_ACTIONS=true pnpm lint exit 0, check-document-region-field-paths.mjs clean over 1060 files, its own selftest OK (19 cases incl. the new ADV-08 case), check-frozen-workflows.mjs OK (322 files, 57 modules), check-parts-parity.mjs OK, check-wiki-dynamic-sql.mjs OK, apps/web full unit suite (node scripts/run-tests.mjs) 5035 tests/5033 pass/0 fail/2 skip, e2e/e2e-fixture-ownership.test.ts 44/44, and the three re-run e2e walks (tenancy-rent-plan-walk 2/2, payroll-settlement-walk 2/2, bank-match-walk 6/6) on the lane's own Playwright triple. Spot-checked the highest-risk blocker/major fixes directly in the migration and script source: ADV-01's reversal-mirror exclusion and ADV-04's is_high_stakes/awaiting_checker parity are present and tail-pinned in 0298; SPEC-08's clara_agent_ro revoke on clara.contract_terms and clara.contract_plan_confirmations, with a tail assertion (has_table_privilege) that raises if a grant returns, is present in 0300; SPEC-02's evaluator-closure claim was moved onto the migration text as the fix report describes; ADV-08's grammarSourceFile() function-name-only candidate selection with a required-roster-shape raise is present and its selftest case is shipped; SPEC-09's approve-writer census in x56-rest-c.test.mjs is built additively, stem-gated (has946Posting/has947Settlement/has948Agreement/has949Tenancy), five to nine, matching the fix report's governance-change framing; SPEC-18/ADV-09's needs-you.ts REVIEW_QUEUE_ROW_KINDS array holds exactly 15 entries matching its own header census; ADV-03's payable_account_in_use refusal is present and tail-asserted. The 64 whole-suite db failures the fix report calls pre-existing rig state were spot-verified: `git log cd2925391..HEAD` is empty for all seven named files, confirming this lane did not touch them. The deliberately unfixed items (SPEC-13's owner question, SPEC-16's out-of-scope nav entry, SPEC-19/SPEC-20's owner/integrator items, L01-STD-3/4's out-of-file-reach and follow-up-ticket items, ADV-03's stated residual) are each argued with a concrete, checkable reason tied to work-order scope-discipline and shared-file rules rather than asserted away, and none of them contradicts the review findings that raised them. Nothing above minor remains open; two minor documentation-accuracy issues survive and are listed below.

findings.title: 0300's own design-rationale comment for clara.contract_terms still claims a clara_agent_ro SELECT the SPEC-08 fix revoked
findings.evidence: packages/db/migrations/0300_tenancy_terms_rent_plan.sql lines ~197-201 (the free-standing comment block above `create table clara.contract_terms`) reads '...a firm-scoped SELECT for clara_authenticated and a firm-scoped SELECT for clara_agent_ro. The runtime role gets NOTHING...' — the pre-fix design. The SPEC-08 fix commit (55b43294a) added the correct 'NO AGENT-LANE GRANT (fix round, finding SPEC-08)' comment and `revoke all on clara.contract_terms from clara_agent_ro;` about 90 lines further down, and separately corrected the `comment on table` SQL comment to say 'the agent lane holds no grant on this table: it has doors' — but did not update this earlier prose block, which a top-down reader hits first and which now directly contradicts the table's actual RLS posture and the fix itself.
findings.required_fix: Update the design-rationale comment block (~line 199) to describe the no-agent-grant posture, or delete the now-false 'a firm-scoped SELECT for clara_agent_ro' clause, so the file does not contradict its own SPEC-08 fix.

findings.title: wave4-lane01-fix.md's own intro finding-count is wrong (27 stated vs 36 actual across the three source reviews)
findings.evidence: wave4-lane01-fix.md line 7-8: 'Twenty-seven findings: ten blockers, seven majors, six minors, four notes.' The three source review JSONs actually carry 36 findings total (spec 21 + standards 4 + adversarial 11), with severities 13 blocker / 9 major / 8 minor / 6 note (10+3 blocker; 5+1+3 major; 3+2+3 minor; 3+1+2 note). The section-3 tables of the SAME report do individually address all 36 (13 blocker rows, 9 major findings across combined rows, 14 minor/note findings across combined rows) — so the miscount is confined to the intro sentence and does not reflect missing coverage, but an integrator who reads only the intro would materially undercount the review's scope.
findings.required_fix: Correct the intro line to 'Thirty-six findings: thirteen blockers, nine majors, eight minors, six notes' (or recompute precisely) so the summary matches the detailed tables below it.
